mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I'm glad you're here, because together, we're about to step into a world that feels both familiar and extraordinary. Think back to your own childhood for a moment—the laughter, the little acts of rebellion, those memories that somehow stay as sharp and colorful as the day they happened. Now, imagine exploring those moments through the eyes of a young boy, whose curiosity and courage are constantly being tested by the wild, unpredictable world around him. That's the journey Roald Dahl invites us on in Boy: Tales of Childhood. We'll wander through strict classrooms and quirky family rituals, taste a few forbidden sweets, and maybe even get into a bit of mischief ourselves—just as Dahl did growing up between Britain and Norway. What makes these stories so special? It's the way each snapshot—every prank, every close call with authority, every warm family moment—reveals the roots of Dahl’s boundless imagination and sharp humor. As we go, we'll discover not just the joys and wonders, but also the challenges and hardships that shaped who he became. So, are you ready to look at childhood through a storyteller’s eyes, to find the adventure and meaning woven into even the smallest memories? Let’s set off together and see what we might remember—and what we might learn—along the way.
